notaire.note: * Indicative estimate of the purchase costs for an existing property, calculated on the range above: transfer duties (4.5 to 5% depending on the department), notary fees under the current statutory scale, land registry contribution and disbursements. The actual amount depends on the final price, the department, any furniture included and the file: only the notary can set it. This information is not contractually binding.
